# Motion — Creative Studio  | Astro

Source: https://astro.build/themes/details/motion-creative-studio/

Who is this template for?

- **Creative, film & motion studios**presenting a reel of work
- **Design & branding agencies**publishing editorial case studies
- **Directors, editors & freelancers**building a video-first portfolio
- **Photographers & content creators**who want a fast, motion-led site

General Features

- **Ultra-fast Performance:**Built with Astro (static-first with React islands) for blazing-fast load times.
- **Light & Dark Theme:**Dark by default, with a complete light palette via design tokens and a persisted preference — no flash on load.
- **Data-driven Reusable Components:**All UI components are powered by centralized data json configs — swap copy, update services, and scale your portfolio without touching component code.
- **Fully Responsive:**Mobile-first layouts that look perfect across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
- **Cinematic Motion:**GSAP entrance and scroll-reveal animations wired to Lenis smooth scrolling, with graceful fallbacks so content always appears.
- **Media-aware Project System:**Point one field at an image, or a Vimeo / YouTube URL and the right player renders automatically — videos lazy-load and autoplay only when scrolled into view.
- **Asymmetric, Filterable Work Grid:**Feature / split / half card layouts with category filtering and a shared case-study engine for projects and stories.
- **SEO Optimized:**Everything in place — auto-generated sitemap, metadata, canonical URL, and Open Graph / Twitter Card tags from a single component.
- **Validated Contact Form:**Zod-validated, spam-resistant form ready to connect to your email provider (e.g. Resend).

Technology Overview

- Astro 7
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS v4
- React 19 (islands)
- GSAP + Lenis (motion & smooth scroll)
- Zod (form validation)

Included Pages & Sections

- **Work (Home):**Animated display hero + asymmetric, filterable project grid.
- **Project Detail:**Editorial case study — challenge, approach, results, gallery, and related work — via dynamic routes.
- **Stories:**Journal / recent-stories index with switchable list and grid views.
- **Story Detail:**Long-form story case study sharing the same layout engine as projects.
- **Contact:**Production-ready, Zod-validated form with an FAQ accordion and contact details.
- **Utility:**Custom 404 page and a prerendered

Additional Highlights

- **Centralized Content System:**Manage all copy, projects, stories, and metadata through JSON config files in — no need to touch components.
- **Reliable on Any Device:**Reveal animations degrade gracefully — content always shows, even on slow connections or iOS Low Power Mode.
- **Protected Media:**Download/right-click-guarded media with automatic video, GIF, and image detection.
- **Comprehensive Documentation:**Detailed README covering structure, theming, animations, and configuration.

License & Usage

By purchasing **Motion — Creative Studio**, you are granted the right to:

- Use the template for personal and commercial projects.
- Customize and adapt the source code for your own brand or your clients.

*Note: Redistribution, resale, or sublicensing of the template in its original or modified form is strictly prohibited.*

# CyberTech - Cybersecurity Consulting Website Template | Astro

Source: https://astro.build/themes/details/cybertech-cybersecurity-consulting-website-template/

CyberTech is a premium Cybersecurity Consulting Agency template built with Astro 7 for security firms, compliance consultants, managed security providers, and vCISO practices that want to showcase expertise, build trust, and convert visitors into high-value engagements.

Designed around real-world security consulting sales cycles, CyberTech combines enterprise-grade credibility, compliance-first messaging, and a calm, authoritative design language to help you present services, frameworks, industries served, and case-proven outcomes with confidence.

**This Theme Supports Astro Version 7.x.x 🎉**

Built specifically for the cybersecurity and compliance consulting industry, CyberTech goes far beyond a typical marketing website. From the homepage and service pages to detailed industry pages, compliance framework pages, case studies, and a 24/7 incident response hotline presence, every section is structured to guide visitors from concern to confidence.

## 🚀 What Makes CyberTech Stand Out

CyberTech is engineered for modern security consulting firms with:

- **Conversion-focused architecture**— every page is designed around trust-building, risk framing, and consultation booking
- **Framework-specific positioning**— dedicated compliance pages for SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, CMMC, NIST, GDPR, and more
- **Industry-specific positioning**— dedicated industry pages for Healthcare, Financial Services, Government & Defense, Manufacturing, Retail, and more
- **Enterprise-grade credibility**— methodology sections, engagement-model breakdowns, deliverables lists, and FAQ blocks included
- **Case study driven marketing**— detailed engagement breakdowns with challenges, solutions, measurable outcomes, and client profiles
- **Reusable TypeScript data layer**— navigation, services, industries, team, testimonials, and page-level copy are editable from structured data files
- **Content Collections for everything that grows**— blog posts, services, industries, compliance frameworks, and case studies are all managed as MDX collections, so adding a new one never requires touching component code
- **24/7 incident response presence**— a persistent breach hotline pattern woven through the hero, footer, and dedicated banners
- **Fully static and SEO-ready**— optimized Astro output with excellent performance and Core Web Vitals

## 🎯 Design DNA

- **Modern Security Consultancy Aesthetic**— navy-and-lime palette, dashed background textures, clean card grids, and an enterprise-inspired visual hierarchy
- **Trust-First UX**— every section is intentionally designed to move visitors toward scheduling a consultation or risk assessment
- **Evidence-Driven Design**— stats, audit outcomes, client renewal rates, certifications, and methodology transparency integrated throughout the experience
- **Interactive Elements**— tabbed service categories, filterable compliance frameworks, accordion FAQs, and timeline-style engagement models, all powered by lightweight Alpine.js
- **Responsive Excellence**— optimized layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile with smooth navigation and interaction patterns

## 📦 Pages Included (Fully Coded)

- ✔ Cybersecurity consulting homepage
- ✔ About page with company story, leadership team, and methodology
- ✔ Services overview page with category tabs and engagement models
- ✔ Service detail pages with overview, challenges, scope, deliverables, and FAQs
- ✔ Industries overview page
- ✔ Industry detail pages (Healthcare, Financial Services, Government & Defense, Manufacturing, and more)
- ✔ Compliance overview page with filterable framework grid
- ✔ Compliance framework detail pages (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, CMMC, NIST CSF, GDPR, and more)
- ✔ Case studies listing page with pagination and category filtering
- ✔ Case study detail pages with challenge, solution, results, and key takeaways
- ✔ Careers page with job listings and an application modal
- ✔ Contact page with a strategy-call lead generation form and IR hotline banner
- ✔ Blog system powered by Astro Content Collections, with pagination and category filtering
- ✔ Blog post detail pages with author profiles, tags, and related posts
- ✔ Webinar page with upcoming sessions and an on-demand library
- ✔ Research & Reports page with a featured report and downloadable library
- ✔ Legal pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy)
- ✔ Custom 404 / Not Found page

## ⚙️ Modern Tech Stack

- **Astro 7**— ultra-fast static site generation
- **Tailwind CSS v4**— utility-first styling with custom design tokens
- **Alpine.js**— lightweight interactions and UI enhancements
- **TypeScript**— type-safe data layer and component architecture
- **MDX**— content management for blog posts, services, industries, compliance frameworks, and case studies
- **Bootstrap Icons**— lightweight icon system via astro-icon
- **Astro Content Collections**— structured, schema-validated content management

## ⚡ Quick Setup

- Download and extract the template
- Run **npm install**
- Start development with **npm run dev**
- Update content in **src/data/**and**src/content/**
- Replace images and branding assets in **public/img/**
- Build production files with **npm run build**

## 🎁 Perfect For

- Cybersecurity Consulting Firms
- Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs)
- Compliance & Audit Advisory Firms
- vCISO Practices
- Penetration Testing & Red Team Companies
- Incident Response Retainer Providers
- Risk Assessment Consultancies
- GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Consultants
- IT Security Boutiques
- Defense & Government Contract Compliance Advisors
- Healthcare Security & HIPAA Consultants
- Anyone selling high-trust cybersecurity or compliance services

## 🆓 Free Updates & Support

CyberTech includes free lifetime updates to maintain compatibility with future Astro releases, performance improvements, and ongoing enhancements.

# Virion | Astro

Source: https://astro.build/themes/details/virion/

Virion is a fintech, SaaS, and technology-business template built on Astro 6 and TypeScript, generating 41 fully static pages per build.

**Pages:** home, about, features, pricing, contact, blog with 13 MDX posts, integrations with 9 MDX integration pages, product catalog with 2 JSON-driven products, cart-aware checkout, PayPal checkout demo, order confirmation, login, sign up, style guide, license, changelog, 401, and 404.

**Near-zero JavaScript** — all pages are prerendered to static HTML; a single vanilla TypeScript module powers navigation, dropdowns, tabs, FAQs, testimonial marquees, scroll animations, and cart functionality. No React, no hydration, and no client framework runtime.

**Content collections** — blog posts and integrations are MDX content collections with zod-validated frontmatter; products are managed through JSON; shared content and navigation live in reusable Astro components. No CMS required.

**Working cart** — JSON-driven products with localStorage persistence, shared across product pages, mini-cart drawer, checkout, and order confirmation flows.

**Design system** — handcrafted CSS architecture with custom-property design tokens for colors, typography, spacing, and branding, all editable from a single stylesheet without framework lock-in.

**Self-hosted fonts** — Inter, Inter Tight, and Island Moments served locally with no third-party font requests.

**Performance-focused** — static rendering, responsive images via native source, semantic HTML, SEO-ready metadata, and clean crawlable URLs.

**Deploy anywhere** — pure static output with no adapter required. Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, AWS Amplify, and standard web hosts support it out of the box.

**Includes** full Astro 6 + TypeScript source code, 41 production-ready pages, MDX content collections, JSON product data, HTML documentation, comprehensive setup guides, and buyer support.

# Storeplate  | Astro

Source: https://astro.build/themes/details/storeplate-astro/

**Updated for Astro v6! 🚀**

**Stroeplate **(formerly shopplate) is a free, production-ready astro.js template powered by Tailwind CSS and TypeScript, specifically designed for Shopify. Utilizes the Shopify Storefront API through GraphQL and provides everything you need to jumpstart your Astro project and save valuable time.

## Key Features:

- Dynamic Products from Shopify Storefront API
- Checkout and Payments with Shopify
- Automatic Light/Dark Mode
- Fetching and Caching Paradigms
- Server Actions for Mutations
- User Authentication
- Similar Products Suggestions
- Search, Sort, Different Views Functionality
- Tags & Categories & Vendors & Price Range & Product Variants Functionality
- Single Product Image Zoom, Hover Effect, Slider
- Cart & Easy editing options for cart items
- Product Description on Multiple Tabs
- Netlify Setting Pre-configured
- Support Contact Form
- Fully Responsive
- Dynamic Home Banner Slider
- Write and Update Content in Markdown / MDX
- Infinite Product Load on Scrolling

## Pages:

- Homepage
- About
